goal: Add deterministic in-process end-to-end failure-injection coverage for the shared proxy control plane: proxy-auth 407 and transport failure drive health/circuit failure, half-open recovery succeeds with hysteresis, generation rotation invalidates an old AccountRuntime, and a fresh runtime generation is admitted.
context: This is a test-harness batch, not a production behavior redesign. Compose existing network.HealthReportingTransport/TransportObserver semantics, proxycontrol state-machine functions, and AccountRuntime.CheckMutationGeneration using fakes. Do not call real DigitalOcean/Vultr APIs, do not require network access, do not add schema, and do not duplicate state-machine logic in production. The test must prove provider-neutral behavior; verification must run both DigitalOcean and Vultr driver suites.
commit_message: test(proxy): prove control-plane failure recovery e2e
